headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss in Cleveland, falling 13-4 to the Guardians. Petey Halpin led the Twins' offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs. In other action, the Yankees defeated the Pirates 8-5, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. hitting 2 home runs and 5 RBIs for the Pirates.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Drey Jameson, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks due to right hip inflammation. The Detroit Tigers also placed Jack Flaherty on the 15-day injured list with right flexor inflammation. Other teams with injured players include the Texas Rangers, Los Angeles Dodgers, Athletics, San Francisco Giants, and Philadelphia Phillies.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a significant trade, acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett, while the Kansas City Royals traded Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded Trey Pooser to the St. Louis Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Twins Suffer Blowout Loss in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians 13-4, marking a tough outing for the Twins. Petey Halpin led the Twins' offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs, while Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians with 6 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 8-5 Loss**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-5, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming from behind in the late innings. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 5-2 defeat at the hands of the Cleveland Guardians, as Parker Messick led the Guardians' pitching staff. Impact hitters for the Guardians included Brayan Rocchio and Gabriel Arias, while Ryan Jeffers and Kody Clemens contributed for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 2-1. Max Muncy and Alec Bohm were among the key contributors in the game, with standout performances from both sides.

top_news.title: **Drey Jameson Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Drey Jameson has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip inflammation, effective retroactive to July 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Seth Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
